headline: Honeywell Technologies Completes Sale of Productivity Solutions and Services Business to Brady Corporation
summary: CHARLOTTE, N.C., August 03, 2026--Honeywell Technologies (NASDAQ: HON) today announced the completion of the sale of its Productivity Solutions and Services (PSS) business to Brady Corporation in an all-cash transaction.

headline: Carrier Completes Sale of NORESCO to OPTERRA Energy Services
summary: Carrier Global Corporation (NYSE: CARR), global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, today announced it has completed the sale of its NORESCO business to OPTERRA Energy Services, a subsidiary of LS Power.

headline: Carrier sells energy service business to Opterra
summary: The Noresco performance contracting business, which spans government and higher education campuses, will help the combined company meet customers’ energy resiliency demands, Opterra said.
